## Additional Tables and Figures 

<!-- ### Random assignment by country -->

```{r random-assignment}
tab <- readRDS("../output/tables/table_country_treatment.rds")
as.data.frame.matrix(addmargins(tab, FUN = list(All = sum), quiet = TRUE)) |>
    kableExtra::kbl(
        caption = "Respondents by Treatment Assignment, per Country",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        linesep = c(rep("", nrow(tab) - 1), "\\addlinespace")
    ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = TRUE)
```

<!-- ## Top Ranked Relocation Mechanisms by Perceived Fairness -->

```{r relocation-weighted, fig.cap = cap, out.width="\\textwidth"}
knitr::include_graphics(
    here::here("output/figures/asylum-relocation-weighted-vs-unweighted.png"),
    auto_pdf = TRUE
)

cap <- "Distribution of top-ranked asylum relocation mechanisms by perceived fairness in weighted and unweighted samples. Weights are based on Eurostat population demographics (2025)." # nolint
```


<!-- ### Perceived Fairness by Country -->

```{r toprank-by-cntry, fig.cap = cap, out.width = "\\textwidth"}
knitr::include_graphics(
    here::here("output/figures/top_rank_by_cntry.png"),
    auto_pdf = TRUE
)

cap <- "Perceived fairness (average rank) by country and information condition" # nolint
```

<!-- ### Anova Table for Heterogenous Treatment Effects  -->

```{r anova}
tab <- readRDS(
    here::here(
        "output", "tables", "anova_table.rds"
    )
)
tab |>
    dplyr::select(-`Interaction added`, -`Base model`) |>
    kableExtra::kbl(
        booktabs = TRUE,
        caption = "ANOVA: Models with vs. without treatment × moderator interactions"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_classic() |>
    kableExtra::footnote(
        "ΔDf = diff. deg. of freedom; F = statistic; p = p-value; ΔR² = diff. R2",
        "Base model: rank ~ alt * treatment * country_type + {moderator}",
    )
```
